for_sales.sales_text:
Wasp is the only John Owles "Windchime" design ever built. She was displayed at the NEC in the 2022 Boat Life Live show alongside the celebrated Windsong racing dinghy. They share a very similar high performance lug rig that can either be sailed as a sloop or cat rigged when the mast stepped in the forward position. This, in effect, is the first reef. Her main has two further reef positions. When sloop rigged a bowsprit is fitted on the stem and a stub mast that extends the overall length by 31 inches. Her construction is glued ply with oak transom and laminated mahogany stem. All trim, rudder, lead weighted centreboard, keel, thwarts, gunwales and knees are in Iroko. Mast, spars, bowsprit and stub mast are spruce. The tiller is ash. Almost all the fittings are from Davey and Co. The high aspect main sail features a 6:1 luff tensioner in addition to the foot tensioner. Sprung outboard bracket fitted. Two long ash oars and rowlocks.

Sail area: Main 87.86sq ft. Jib 36.78sq ft

Wasp comes complete with a breakback road trailer. New 2021.

For further details, see the Summer Boat Design website.
